title: the dove and the olive leaf

verses.text: And behold, the dove returned to him in the evening with a freshly plucked olive leaf in her beak. So Noah knew that the waters had receded from the earth.

caption:
Waiting does not mean nothing is happening under the water.

Noah had no way to see the ground drying. He sent a dove, and she came back in the evening with one small green leaf, and that was enough to know. Sometimes God gives the whole shoreline. Sometimes He gives a leaf, and asks you to trust what it means.

Genesis 8:11 (BSB)
